description: Every ratio the figures allow, in one call: valuation, profitability, liquidity, solvency, efficiency, risk (Altman Z, Z'', Piotroski) and quality. Every figure is optional; a metric whose figures are missing comes back null and is named. With withInsights, each metric also gets a status and a one-line reading.

annualDividendPerShare.description: Dividends per share over one year

costOfRevenue.description: Cost of revenue, as a positive number

eps.description: Earnings per share, trailing twelve months or last fiscal year

expectedEarningsGrowthRate.description: Expected yearly EPS growth as a decimal, e.g. 0.15 (PEG)

freeCashFlow.description: Operating cash flow minus capital expenditure

grossProfit.description: Gross profit, used when cost of revenue is not given

interestExpense.description: Interest expense, as a positive number

returns.description: Return for the period as a decimal (Sharpe)

riskFree.description: Risk-free rate for the same period as a decimal (Sharpe)

stdDev.description: Standard deviation of returns for the same period (Sharpe)

taxRate.description: Effective tax rate as a decimal, e.g. 0.25 (ROIC)

withInsights.description: Optional: add a status (Good, Neutral, Bad, N/A) and a one-line reading to each metric

workingCapital.description: Current assets minus current liabilities; worked out from them when left out

name: analyze_company
title: Company analysis (every ratio at once)
